LOCAL DERIVATIVES AND RETAINED SOURCES
The source GLBs remain unchanged. Local derivatives include orientation and
pivot normalization, explicit triangulation, three mesh LODs, PBR texture
conversion and Unreal import. BaseColor retains the source colour; Normal
retains the embedded normal map; ORM packs R=constant unoccluded AO,
G=source roughness and B=source metallic. Prepared PBR maps are 2,048 pixels.
The shuttle uses uniform sphere normalization and a measured DockingCollar
anchor. The three arks use documented per-axis stock hull dimensions;
that anisotropic normalization intentionally changes their raw proportions.
Terran and Organic use the R3 normal repairs: respectively two and four
invalid LOD0 corner normals were replaced. Supported Blender storage drift
of previously valid directions is bounded to one degree. Their geometry,
indices, UVs and PBR were preserved; unchanged LOD1/2 FBX bytes come from R1.
The preparation and import receipts below identify these actual derivatives.
